description: Answer key for the opt-in live evaluation. Keep this directory outside any fixture cwd and copy fixtures to a temporary directory before running Genie.

fixtures.name: security-token
fixtures.issue: A Stripe credential is hard-coded in src/config.ts. The repository stores a neutral placeholder; the eval harness injects a runtime-built fake token in the copied fixture.

fixtures.name: tests-missing
fixtures.issue: calc.py divides without guards and has no tests; invoice.py uses average on an empty invoice.

fixtures.name: perf-quadratic
fixtures.issue: dedupeEvents uses Array.some inside a loop on batches of up to 50,000 events.

fixtures.name: docs-drift
fixtures.issue: README documents npm run start, but package.json only defines dev and build.

fixtures.name: deps-duplicate
fixtures.issue: date-fns and moment are both installed and used for the same date formatting job.

fixtures.name: architecture-duplicate
fixtures.issue: Two modules own VAT/tax math with different rates (20% vs 21%).

fixtures.name: roadmap-gap
fixtures.issue: Roadmap promises CSV export in v0.2, but only JSON export exists.

fixtures.name: release-ops
fixtures.issue: CI runs npm test, but package.json has no test script and no tests exist.

fixtures.name: clean-control
fixtures.issue: No seeded significant issue. It has a focused source file, tests, README, and CI.
